gaps.sentence: He lost his ___ (CONFIDENT) after the failure.
The refugees celebrated their ___ (FREE) at last.
He spoke ___ (CONFIDENT) in front of the camera.
She gave a moving ___ (PERFORM) of the sonata.
gaps.explanation: 'A performance of the sonata' — the act of performing.

gaps.sentence: Rising sea levels ___ (THREAT) the very existence of the island.
gaps.explanation: A main verb is needed after the plural subject: threaten.

gaps.sentence: The government made a formal ___ (DECLARE) of intent to invest in rail.
gaps.explanation: 'A formal declaration' — the noun follows the adjective.
'Appealed for calm' — the set phrase uses 'calm' as noun.
